description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) used for filtering search parameters related to Claim Expense Types within the OrangeHRM Claim module. It includes properties for filter criteria such as name, status, and ID, and initializes default sorting behavior.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseTypeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO extending FilterParams to encapsulate filtering and sorting parameters specifically for searching claim expense types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'expenseType.name'.
